Regular Meeting City Council
AGENDA
la puente Regular Meeting City Council
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
FEBRUARY 14, 2012
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL MEMBERS: House, Mendoza, Holloway, Argudo, Solis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION TO THE CITY COUNCIL BY MICHAEL CACCIOTTI, SOUTH COAST AIR DISTRICT (10 Minutes)
PRESENTATION TO THE CITY COUNCIL BY MICHAEL CACCIOTTI, SOUTH COAST AIR DISTRICT (10 Minutes)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETING - None.
B.
PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1313 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2011-12
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution approving Warrant Register No. 1313.
CC.D-1 Resoultion Warrant Register #1313
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR THE VALLEY BOULEVARD IMPROVEMENT PROJECT (PHASE II)
It is recommended that the City Council (1) Approve the plans and specifications for the Valley Boulevard Improvement Project (Phase II); and (2) authorize Staff to solicit bids.
CC.D-2 Authorization to solicit bids-Valley Blvd Phase II Report
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR THE HANDICAPPED RAMPS AND SIDEWALKS PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council award a contract in the amount of $78,295 to Gentry Brothers, Inc. for the installation of Handicapped Ramps and Sidewalks.
CC.D-3 Handicapped Ramps and Sidewalks-award of contract report and Attachments A-B
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
PROPOSED ISSUANCE OF REFUNDING BONDS TO REPAY AND RESTRUCTURE THE LEASE AGREEMENT RELATIVE TO THE COMMUNITY CENTER AND YOUTH LEARNING ACTIVITY CENTER AND APPROVAL OF AGREEMENTS WITH THE CITY'S FINANCE TEAM OF URBAN FUTURES, INC.; JONES HALL; AND DE LA ROSA & CO.
It is recommended that the City Council 1) Approve professional services contracts for financial advisory services with Urban Futures, Inc.; for bond counsel and disclosure counsel services with Jones Hall; and for Underwriting services with De La Rosa & Co.; and 2) Authorize the Finance Team to prepare the financing and legal documents necessary to provide for the issuance of the proposed refunding bonds.
CC.E-1 City Staff Report re authorization to proceed and contracts and Attachments A-C
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE (1) SUPPORTING A REORGANIZATION OF CITY PERSONNEL AND AMENDING THE CITY OF LA PUENTE CLASSIFICATION PLAN, COMPENSATION PLAN, AND TABLE OF ORGANIZATION; AND (2) RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 11-4945, AND AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM AND ESTABLISHING THE NUMBER OF AUTHORIZED POSITIONS, MONTHLY SALARY RANGES AND HOURLY RATES FOR CITY EMPLOYEES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt a resolution supporting a reorganization of City Personnel and amending the City Classification Plan, Compensation Plan, and Table of Organization; and (2) adopt a resolution rescinding Resolution No. 11-4945, and amending the comprehensive personnel system and establishing the number of authorized positions, monthly salary ranges and hourly rates for City employees.
CC.E-2 HR Staff Report Adopting Resolution of Reorganization and Attachments A-D
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING SECTION 2.13 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO EXCEPTIONS TO THE CIVIL SERVICE SYSTEM
It is recommended that the City Council 1) Waive further reading of the Ordinance and read by title only; and 2) Introduce Ordinance - an Ordinance of the City of La Puente, amending Section 2.13 of the La Puente Municipal code relating to exceptions of the Civil Service System.
CC.E-3 HR Staff Report Civil Service Ordinance and Attachment A
E-4
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION ON ADOPTING CONSTRUCTION COST ACCOUNTING PROCEDURES FROM STATE CONTROLLER JOHN CHIANG (Mayor Pro-Tem Argudo Report to Follow)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-5
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REQUIRING CITY COUNCIL APPROVAL TO TRAVEL PRIOR TO ATTENDING A CONFERENCE (Mayor Pro-Tem Argudo)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-6
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION TO DESIGNATE APRIL 2012 AS "MAKE LA PUENTE BEAUTIFUL MONTH" (Council Member House)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-7
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING PARKING ENFORCEMENT STRATEGIES (Mayor Solis)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-6
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION TO DESIGNATE APRIL 2012 AS "MAKE LA PUENTE BEAUTIFUL MONTH" (Council Member House)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-7
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING PARKING ENFORCEMENT STRATEGIES (Mayor Solis)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
F.
CLOSED SESSION
F-1
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS INTO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 545956.9(a), EXISTING LITIGATION, Trinity Wellness Center Inc, et al., v. City of La Puente, Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. BC472548
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION

ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF

Central during normal business hours. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City?s website at http://www.lapuente.org
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk?s Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
